issuers.company: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
issuers.sector: Steel processing centre (coated steel for appliances)
issuers.brlm: Smart Horizon Capital Advisors Private Limited
issuers.headline: A four-plant steel processor feeding India's AC and refrigerator makers (FY26 revenue Rs 1,267 cr, up 20%; PAT Rs 30.5 cr), raising Rs 183 cr of fresh money mainly to repay debt, priced at 16.9x FY26 earnings after the issue (13.2x pro forma for lower interest), below the Rs 88 paid by investors in Oct-2025; fair value Rs 110 (Neutral) against Rs 82.
red_flags: Revenue Rs 755.26 cr -> Rs 1,266.82 cr FY24-26 (29.5% CAGR); Q1 FY27 Rs 397.08 cr with adjusted EBITDA margin 8.10% (6.80% in FY26) (pp. 85, 131)
Debt/equity 2.78x (FY26), 2.00x (Jun-26); finance cost 41% of FY26 EBITDA; Rs 125 cr of the issue repays debt (pp. 84-85, 117, 132)
JSW Steel Coated Products 86.65% of FY26 coil supply under a terminable agreement; appliances 86.54% of product revenue; Amber 20.40%, top-10 71.33% (pp. 30-31, 35, 37)
Cumulative CFO/PAT 67% FY24-26 as inventory rose to Rs 189 cr; Q1 FY27 CFO Rs 72.31 cr as it was released (pp. 84, 86)
25 delayed RoC filings and a 2021 allotment-filing error; RoC adjudication still pending; promoter loans Rs 20.55 cr at interest (pp. 32-33, 89-92)
Fair value Rs 103 / 110 / 126 at Rs 82 (Bear / Neutral / Bull); DCF Rs 53 (Neutral) vs peer value Rs 168; reported P/E a fair measure (adjustments -3.1%)

issuers.company: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited
issuers.business_stage: Early scaling (5 showrooms, expanding with issue-funded inventory)
issuers.headline: A fast-growing Mumbai-Ahmedabad jewellery retailer (5 showrooms, 13% EBITDA margin) raising Rs 220 cr of fresh money to stock new showrooms, priced at 23x annualised earnings against a 22x peer median; our fair value is Rs 120 (Neutral) because inventory-heavy growth leaves little free cash flow.
red_flags: Revenue Rs 217.32 cr (FY24) -> Rs 351.28 cr (FY25) -> Rs 360.82 cr in 9M FY26; EBITDA margin 5.9% -> 11.0% -> 13.4%, helped by rising gold prices (pp. 101, 227)
Inventory Rs 240.59 cr (205 days); operating cash flow negative FY23-25, +Rs 18.01 cr in 9M FY26; no gold hedging disclosed (pp. 101, 226, 228)
Promoter's proprietorship merged in Mar-2025 for 40.38 lakh shares (Rs 71.07 cr); Rs 21.52 cr of FY25 purchases from it before the merger (pp. 64, 189)
Ahmedabad showrooms 62.40% of 9M FY26 revenue; five showrooms in two cities (pp. 23, 91)
RHP not reachable: DRHP (May-2026) figures used; fair value Rs 103 / 120 / 141 vs Rs 162

issuers.sector: Polymer compounds for wires, cables and pipe coating
issuers.headline: A profitable, cash-generative polymer compounder doubling capacity, priced at 34.5x FY26 earnings after the issue against a 14.5x peer median; our fair value is Rs 81 (Neutral) against Rs 150, because growth in the core manufactured business has been flat and the price already pays for the expansion.
red_flags: Operating EBITDA margin 5.5% -> 9.7% -> 12.0% FY24-26 (14.5% in Q1 FY27); PAT Rs 7.52 cr -> Rs 27.01 cr; cumulative CFO 118% of PAT (pp. 85-86)
Capacity to rise from 35,251 to 87,301 MTPA (+148%) by FY28 from Rs 77.56 cr of proceeds; current utilisation 73-75% (pp. 123-124)
Manufactured revenue flat to lower (Rs 254 cr -> Rs 237 cr FY24-26); growth came from resin trading, 31.9% of FY26 revenue (pp. 33, 406, 408)
Top customer 31.7% of FY26 revenue; top supplier 71.7% of procurement; purchases from promoter-group trader Vinsul Makardi 9.3% of revenue (pp. 27, 39, 89)
At Rs 150: P/E 34.5x post-issue vs peer median 14.5x (DDev Plastiks 13.0x, Kingfa 46.3x); reported P/E is a fair measure (earnings-quality adjustments -2.8%)
Fair value Rs 68 / 81 / 96 (Bear / Neutral / Bull) vs Rs 150; objects floor Rs 98; issuer KPI EBITDA leaves other income in (Rs 46.60 cr vs Rs 41.90 cr operating)

issuers.brlm: IIFL Capital Services Limited; JM Financial Limited; Nuvama Wealth Management Limited
issuers.business_stage: Established leader in its core, scaling into new segments
issuers.headline: India's dominant SBR sewage-treatment technology supplier (705 plants, 29.3% operating margin) priced at 20.9x FY26 earnings at Rs 330, against 31-52x for listed peers; our fair value is Rs 392 (Neutral), so Subscribe. Watch cash conversion (FY26 operating cash flow negative) and the Goa plant notices.
red_flags: Revenue Rs 657.50 -> 697.86 -> 803.63 cr FY24-26 (+15.2% in FY26); operating EBITDA margin about 29%; order book Rs 1,574.52 cr (2.0x revenue) (RHP pp. 188, 412)
Operating cash flow -Rs 25.80 cr in FY26 and -Rs 21.34 cr in Q1 FY27; cumulative FY24-26 CFO 6% of PAT; working capital 76.5% of revenue (pp. 411, 417)
Ten show-cause notices from the Goa pollution board and GWMC to the SWT subsidiaries since Jul-2025, plus an FIR; EUR 5.60 m Portugal claim pending (pp. 554-557)
Offer Rs 667.5 cr at Rs 330: fresh Rs 150 cr + OFS 1.57 crore shares (78%) by sellers with an average cost of Rs 36.72; Rs 28.02 cr interim dividend declared Sep-2026 (cover; p. 510)
At Rs 330: P/E 20.9x post-issue (Ion Exchange 31.3x, Thermax 52.0x); fair value Rs 358 / 392 / 423; reported P/E a fair measure (adjustments -1.0%)

issuers.sector: Alternative asset management (real assets, private credit)
issuers.brlm: Axis Capital; Jefferies India; Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors; Nuvama Wealth Management
issuers.headline: A scaled alternatives manager (fee-paying AUM Rs 48,623 cr, +27% a year) priced at 41x FY26 earnings, in line with listed asset managers (median 38.7x); our fair value is Rs 1,130 (Neutral) because the DCF does not support peer multiples and profit benefits from capitalised distribution costs. Avoid at Rs 1,665, narrowly; it would be Neutral at about Rs 1,615 or below.
red_flags: Revenue from operations Rs 492.58 cr -> Rs 869.54 cr FY24-26 (+33% a year); Q1 FY27 +44%; fee-paying AUM Rs 48,623 cr at Jun-26 (Add. pp. 7, 107)
Carry (Variable Additional Return) Rs 290.47 cr = 33% of FY26 revenue, booked at fair value; realised carry Rs 430.69 cr in FY26 and Rs 338.10 cr in Q1 FY27 (Add. pp. 7, 108)
Distribution costs capitalised: prepaid balance Rs 667.94 cr at Jun-26; expensing the FY26 increase would cut pre-tax profit by Rs 167.03 cr - adjusted P/E 73.6x vs 40.8x reported (part 5)
Pure OFS of Rs 1,200 cr by Edelweiss Securities and Investments; Rs 205.70 cr dividend paid to the group in FY26; MD & CEO resigned Sep-2025 (DRHP p. 272; Add. p. 108)
At Rs 1,665: P/E 40.8x on diluted shares (peer median 38.7x), P/B 9.3x; fair value Rs 1,033 / 1,130 / 1,214 (Bear / Neutral / Bull)

issuers.sector: Defence electronics: electro-optic and thermal imaging systems
issuers.brlm: JM Financial Limited; IIFL Capital Services Limited
issuers.headline: A leading Indian thermal-imaging OEM that owns its technology, priced at 78.8x FY26 earnings against an 85.6x peer median; our Neutral fair value is Rs 515 (-26% vs Rs 700) because FY26 was a down year with cash tied up in orders, and the outcome turns on how quickly the Rs 432 cr of orders convert.
red_flags: Owns 100% of its IP; largest supplier of thermal imaging to Indian government agencies Apr-24 to Mar-26 (issuer-paid F&S report, pp. 246, 253)
EBITDA margin 26.2% / 29.7% / 28.9% FY24-26 and cash tax 23.3% of PBT (pp. 89, 144)
Orders of Rs 432 cr in hand (Rs 314 cr book at Jun-26 plus Rs 118 cr won Jul-Sep), about 1.2x FY26 revenue (p. 250)

FY26 revenue -22.7% as export orders slipped; reported P/E 78.8x is flattered by a Rs 18.84 cr warranty write-back and Rs 34.17 cr of capitalised development (adjusted FY26 P/E 247.5x; three-year average 75.6x) (pp. 23, 351, 373)
Priced at 78.8x FY26 EPS and 7.2x book vs peer medians 85.6x and 13.0x (pp. 141, our computation)
Fair value Rs 486 / 515 / 556 (Bear / Neutral / Bull) vs Rs 700; QIB book 293.6x at close (NSE)
